fields.accordionHeading: How do I update my personal information, including demographic changes and/or life changing events, such as family size, income, relocation, etc.?
fields.accordionDescription:
Submit these updates through your respective Marketplace Exchange by going to:
California members, go to CoveredCA.com or call (800) 300-1506.
Washington members, go to WAHealthPlanFinder.org or call (855) 923-4633.
New Mexico members, go to BeWellnm.com or call (833) 862-3935.
Kentucky members, go to Kynect.ky.gov or call (855) 459-6328.
Idaho members, go to YourHealthIdaho.org or call (855) 944-3246.
Nevada members, go to NevadaHealthLink.com or call 1-800-547-2927.

For all other states, go to Account Settings and click on ‘Update’ under the Personal or Plan information section.

**Updates to personal or plan information can only be made by the Subscriber.
